# Lock and unlock a selected performance point by clicking it

> Prove a chart point click locks selection with persistent point, tooltip, and lock icon, and a second click on the same point unlocks it.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Performance chart, hover a visible data point so its tooltip is available for selection.

## Step 3

Click the visible hovered chart point once and confirm the point stays visible, the tooltip stays visible, and a lock icon appears.

## Step 4

capture baseline: locked chart-point selection after the first click.

## Step 5

Click the same locked chart point a second time and confirm the lock icon disappears and the chart returns to an unlocked selection state.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-24, ac-26, ac-27, ac-28, ac-29, ac-30

Confirm state-transition check: no locked chart-point selection (equals) — the stated promise: A second click on the locked chart point unlocks the selection.
